slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Does God’s holiness predict Jesus? Exodus praises the LORD as “majestic in holiness.” Luke calls Jesus the Holy One, and Acts calls him God’s holy servant.
slides.body: Exodus praises the LORD as “majestic in holiness.” Luke calls Jesus the Holy One, and Acts calls him God’s holy servant.
slides.heading: Does God’s holiness predict Jesus?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Exod 15:11: Who among the gods is like You, O LORD? Who is like You — majestic in holiness, revered with praises, performing wonders?
slides.body: Who among the gods is like You, O LORD? Who is like You — majestic in holiness, revered with praises, performing wonders?
slides.heading: Exod 15:11

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Lk 1:35, BSB: The Holy One to be born will be called the Son of God.
slides.body: The Holy One to be born will be called the Son of God.
slides.heading: Claimed fulfilment · Lk 1:35

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Why Christians connect them Christians believe Jesus shows people what God is like. A holy saviour who shares God’s character makes sense within that belief.
slides.body: Christians believe Jesus shows people what God is like. A holy saviour who shares God’s character makes sense within that belief.
slides.heading: Why Christians connect them

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: But the song is about God Exodus praises the LORD for rescuing Israel from Egypt. It does not describe a future saviour. Jesus may share that holiness, but the song does not predict him.
slides.body: Exodus praises the LORD for rescuing Israel from Egypt. It does not describe a future saviour. Jesus may share that holiness, but the song does not predict him.
slides.heading: But the song is about God
